result.topic_en: Draft notes on the behaviour of a function \vartheta (theta function) on a cut Riemann surface T': it becomes infinitely small of first order at p points \eta_1,...,\eta_p, \log\vartheta changes by 2\pi i around these points, and the periodicity moduli along the cross-cuts a, b, c are determined via integrals of \log\vartheta.
